ALGER — Algérie Télécom annonce des hora: ALGIERS — Algérie Télécom announces extended opening hours for its commercial agencies on Sunday, July 5, 2026, on the occasion of the 64th anniversary of Independence and Youth. The public operator reaffirms its commitment to ensuring the continuity of fixed telephony and connectivity services across the entire territory.
L'opérateur public Algérie Télécom a pub: The public operator Algérie Télécom published, on Saturday, July 4, 2026, the exceptional hours for its commercial agencies for Sunday, July 5, 2026. This organization aims to maintain a minimal service during this public holiday, while taking into account the climatic and geographical particularities of the country's different regions.
Deux tranches horaires distinctes ont ét: Two distinct time slots have been defined to meet customer needs. For the northern wilayas, excluding the wilaya of Algiers, commercial agencies located in wilaya capitals will be open from 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM. In Algiers, twelve specific agencies will provide service during the same hours: Hussein Dey, Bordj El Kiffan, Bab Ezzouar, Aïn Taya, Ben M'hidi, Aïn Naâdja, Hydra, Birtouta, Chéraga, Ben Aknoun, Zéralda, and El Biar.
Dans les wilayas du Sud, les agences com: In the southern wilayas, commercial agencies in the capitals will be accessible from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM. This organization reflects the company's desire to guarantee a minimal presence in the field to meet subscribers' requests, even on public holidays.
Le communiqué d'Algérie Télécom souligne: Algérie Télécom's press release emphasizes that this measure is part of a continuous approach to bringing public services closer to citizens. The stated objective is to facilitate access to fixed telephony and connectivity services, even during holiday periods.
Le service Communication de l'opérateur: The public operator's Communication Department specified that this exceptional organization aims to ensure the continuity of essential services, while adapting schedules to local realities.
